entry: The map now shows a brief pulse when a ship leaves a colony (a ring growing outward) or arrives at one (a ring closing in). Nothing is drawn if you have reduced motion on.
Trade posts: once every automation slot is in use you can establish a trade post in each reachable star system (400 credits each), earning 2 credits per tick with no ship needed.

Market speculation: every good now has a small stockpile (15 units). Buy 5 while a price is crashed, hold it, and sell once the price recovers. Buying pushes the price up, selling pushes it down and pays a 10% fee.
Colony investment: each undeveloped colony has an Invest button that spends 60 credits to add 10 units of development progress, so spare credits can speed up a colony's growth and specialization.

Research specialization: after Automation Expansion II you choose an Automation path (+10% on automated ships' sales, then +1 automation slot) or a Market path (prices recover 50% faster, then drop 30% less per sale). Picking one closes the other for good.
When you buy ship 5 or 6 you now choose its type: Balanced, Cargo-heavy (carries 50% more but is one tick slower) or Fast (one tick quicker but carries 25% less).

New optional Route hazards and Route insurance toggles in the Market prices panel: with hazards on, 8% of loaded arrivals lose their cargo; insurance costs 1 credit per ship in transit per tick and refunds 75% of a lost trip.
Diplomatic relations: units you deliver between star systems now build relations (3 levels), each giving a permanent +5% on every sale.
New optional Seasonal demand toggle in the Market prices panel: every 30 ticks two goods are in demand and sell for 25% more, with the current and next pair always shown. Nothing is ever marked down.
New Trade almanac in the Market prices panel: each good's baseline price, typical range, and which colony makes and needs it.
Hover over the endgame galaxy dots to see which background world you're pointing at.
A small spark/particle burst now plays briefly on a high-value sale (200+ credits).

Round-2 quality pass: ship name reset, veteran-hauler badge, route trend arrows, fleet-efficiency and galaxy overview in Summary, map legend and Fleet Priority ring tooltip, crash recovery ETA, locked-research tooltips, labeled price-now marker, needs-met average.
Confirm-before-spending dialogs added for automating a ship or unlocking research (both rare, irreversible, high-cost actions).
Settings panel: adjustable text size and a Reduce Motion toggle.
Gap-closing pass: colorblind-safety audit confirmed (automated vs. manual ships already distinguished by shape, not just color).
Achievements added: 19 achievements, in-game panel, unlock toast, hub dashboard link.
Mobile: a condensed colony-needs strip now docks to the bottom of the screen so it's visible alongside the ship panels.
Skippable tutorial, a How to Play page, and a mobile sticky HUD.
Space-theme visual pass: starfield background, glass panels, gradient buttons.
Bug fixes: Kepler Cluster map labels no longer collide; hub-link paths corrected.

All 14 milestones shipped: manual trade loop, colony needs and market economics, automation, the 2D map, research tree, colony specialization, fleet-level automation, galaxy expansion, and the fully-automated endgame.
